```{r, echo=TRUE}
## ==========================================================
## TFCE analysis in R for exported within-subject EEG CSV
##
## Input files:
##   ../data/05_designTable.csv
##   ../data/05_EEGdata_long.csv
##
## Model:
##   Amplitude ~ CondCode + (1|Subject)
##
## Permutation:
##   Rearrange condition labels within each subject
##   EEG data itself is never permuted
## ==========================================================

rm(list = ls())

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)

source("../R/tfce_transform.R")

cat("\nStarting TFCE within-subject analysis...\n")

## ==========================================================
## -1. Load CSV files
## ==========================================================

designTable <- read.csv("../data/05_designTable.csv")
EEGlong     <- read.csv("../data/05_EEGdata_long.csv")

print(names(designTable))
print(names(EEGlong))

## ==========================================================
## 0. Merge EEG data with design table
## ==========================================================

designTable <- designTable %>%
  mutate(RowID = row_number())

dat <- EEGlong %>%
  left_join(designTable, by = c("Subject", "CondCode")) %>%
  mutate(
    Subject = factor(Subject),
    Channel = factor(Channel),
    CondCode = as.numeric(CondCode)
  )

channels <- unique(dat$Channel)
times    <- sort(unique(dat$Time))

n_chan <- length(channels)
n_time <- length(times)

## ==========================================================
## -2. Function to compute LME t-map
## ==========================================================

compute_tmap <- function(data) {
  
  res <- data %>%
    group_by(Channel, Time) %>%
    summarise(
      t_value = coef(summary(
        lmer(Amplitude ~ CondCode + (1 | Subject), data = cur_data())
      ))["CondCode", "t value"],
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  tmat <- res %>%
    mutate(
      Channel = factor(Channel, levels = channels),
      Time = factor(Time, levels = times)
    ) %>%
    arrange(Channel, Time) %>%
    pull(t_value)
  
  matrix(
    tmat,
    nrow = n_chan,
    ncol = n_time,
    byrow = TRUE,
    dimnames = list(channels, times)
  )
}

## ==========================================================
## Step 1: Observed t-map
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 1: Computing observed t-map...\n")

t_Obs <- compute_tmap(dat)

cat("Observed t-map completed.\n")

## ==========================================================
## Step 2: Observed TFCE map
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 2: Computing observed TFCE map...\n")

TFCE_Obs <- tfce_transform(
  t_Obs,
  E  = 0.66,
  H  = 2,
  dh = 0.1
)

cat("Observed TFCE map completed.\n")

## ==========================================================
## Step 3: Permutation distribution
## ==========================================================

set.seed(123)

n_perm <- 1
TFCE_permMax <- rep(NaN, n_perm)

subject_info <- designTable %>%
  select(RowID, Subject, CondCode)

for (p in seq_len(n_perm)) {
  
  perm_info <- subject_info %>%
    group_by(Subject) %>%
    mutate(CondCode = sample(CondCode)) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  perm_dat <- EEGlong %>%
    left_join(perm_info, by = "RowID") %>%
    mutate(
      Subject = factor(Subject),
      Channel = factor(Channel),
      CondCode = as.numeric(CondCode)
    )
  
  t_perm <- compute_tmap(perm_dat)
  
  TFCE_perm <- tfce_transform(
    t_perm,
    E  = 0.66,
    H  = 2,
    dh = 0.1
  )
  
  TFCE_permMax[p] <- max(abs(TFCE_perm), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  if (p %% 50 == 0) {
    cat("Permutation", p, "of", n_perm, "\n")
  }
}

## ==========================================================
## Step 4: TFCE-corrected significance
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 4: Computing TFCE-corrected significance...\n")

alpha <- 0.05
nPerm <- length(TFCE_permMax)

maxTFCE <- sort(c(TFCE_permMax, max(abs(TFCE_Obs), na.rm = TRUE)))
maxTFCEcrit <- maxTFCE[round(nPerm * (1 - alpha))]

Mask <- abs(TFCE_Obs) >= maxTFCEcrit

P_Values <- matrix(
  NA_real_,
  nrow = nrow(TFCE_Obs),
  ncol = ncol(TFCE_Obs),
  dimnames = dimnames(TFCE_Obs)
)

for (ch in seq_len(n_chan)) {
  for (t in seq_len(n_time)) {
    
    P_Values[ch, t] <-
      (sum(TFCE_permMax >= abs(TFCE_Obs[ch, t]), na.rm = TRUE) + 1) /
      (nPerm + 1)
  }
}

cat("TFCE-corrected significance completed.\n")
cat(sprintf("Critical TFCE value = %.4f\n", maxTFCEcrit))

## ==========================================================
## Step 5: Store results
## ==========================================================

cat("Step 5: Storing results...\n")

Results <- list(
  tObs         = t_Obs,
  TFCE_Obs     = TFCE_Obs,
  TFCE_Null    = TFCE_permMax,
  maxTFCEcrit  = maxTFCEcrit,
  P_Values     = P_Values,
  Mask         = Mask,
  alpha        = alpha,
  nPerm        = nPerm
)

cat("Results stored.\n")

## ==========================================================
## Step 6: Plot TFCE-corrected significant t-values
## ==========================================================

sigT <- t_Obs
sigT[!Mask] <- 0

times_num <- as.numeric(colnames(t_Obs))
channels  <- rownames(t_Obs)
nChan     <- nrow(t_Obs)

image(
  x = times_num,
  y = seq_len(nChan),
  z = t(sigT),
  xlab = "Time (ms)",
  ylab = "Channel",
  main = "TFCE-corrected Significant Effects",
  axes = FALSE
)

axis(1, at = seq(-200, 800, by = 200))
axis(
  2,
  at = seq_len(nChan),
  labels = channels,
  las = 2,
  cex.axis = 0.7
)
box()

## ==========================================================
## Step 7: Plot observed TFCE map
## ==========================================================

image(
  x = times_num,
  y = seq_len(nChan),
  z = t(TFCE_Obs),
  xlab = "Time (ms)",
  ylab = "Channel",
  main = "Observed TFCE Map",
  axes = FALSE
)

axis(1, at = seq(-200, 800, by = 200))
axis(
  2,
  at = seq_len(nChan),
  labels = channels,
  las = 2,
  cex.axis = 0.7
)
box()

## ==========================================================
## Step 8: Save TFCE results
## ==========================================================

if (!dir.exists("../results")) {
  dir.create("../results")
}

save(
  Results,
  t_Obs,
  TFCE_Obs,
  TFCE_permMax,
  maxTFCEcrit,
  P_Values,
  Mask,
  times_num,
  channels,
  file = "../results/05_TFCE_within_subject_results.RData"
)

cat("TFCE within-subject analysis completed and results saved.\n")
